# Ryle Anthony Gabotero

> Software engineer based in Negros Island Region, Philippines, specializing in backend systems, cybersecurity, and applied AI.

## Summary
Ryle Anthony Gabotero is a software engineer and national cybersecurity competitor. He represents the Negros Island Region in competitive cybersecurity skills (WorldSkills Philippines) and builds full-stack systems, computer vision edge pipelines, and low-latency network applications.

- **Location**: Negros Island Region, Philippines (UTC+8)
- **Education**: Foundation University
- **Status**: Available for software engineering roles, technical collaboration, and remote work.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Backend Architecture & APIs**: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Laravel, CodeIgniter, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis caching, WebSockets, streaming reverse proxies, transactional data integrity.
- **Cybersecurity & Networking**: Network packet analysis, Wireshark, Scapy, Linux and Windows Server hardening, threat modeling, defensive security, incident response.
- **Applied AI & Computer Vision**: Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Tesseract OCR, edge inference (ESP32 IoT integration).
- **Frontend & Mobile**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Kotlin, Unity, ARCore (geospatial SLAM).

- **Advanced Big Data Analytics & Artificial Intelligence**: 120-hour intensive program by KOICA DX Center, Hannam University, and Silliman University. Scored 10/10 in Deep Learning Architecture domain across 7 assessed areas.
- **TOPCIT ICT Competency Assessment**: Level 2 certified (Score: 365 / 1000) covering software development, systems architecture, data management, and cybersecurity.

## Selected Projects & Code Repositories
- **SafeView**: Windows security agent for real-time visual phishing detection using Tesseract OCR and semantic sentence embeddings for sub-50ms local inference with zero cloud dependency.
  - Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/SafeView
  - Live Demo: https://safe-view.vercel.app/
- **OvaLens Ecosystem**: Automated duck egg candling and fertility sorting via a custom YOLOv8 computer vision model, camera exposure controls, Python edge client, and ESP32 conveyor actuation.
  - Model Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/OvaLens-Ecosystem
  - Edge App Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/OvaLens---Edge-App
- **myAnime & HLS Proxy Server**: Custom Node.js streaming architecture with an Express HLS relay, byte-range video streaming, LRU disk/memory caching, Redis, and PostgreSQL relational schema.
  - Project Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/myAnime
  - Proxy Relay Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/proxy-server
- **AR Chronicle**: Native Android augmented reality exploration app integrating ARCore SLAM plane detection, Unity, and OpenStreetMap geofencing for landmark discovery.
  - Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/ARChroniclesmainAPP
- **Pickle World**: Multi-court reservation engine featuring WebSocket concurrency slot locks, webhook payment reconciliation, and strict transaction isolation in MySQL.
  - Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/pickleball_reservation_system
